suffix.close: One clear subject, framed close and large: it fills most of the picture and reaches into every quarter of it, so any quarter of the picture shows a recognisable part of it. A calm, simple background in strong contrast with the subject, with only gentle texture. Strong shapes and clear, bold colours. No text, letters, numbers, logos, brand names, signature, watermark, border or frame.
suffix.close2: One clear subject, framed close and large: it fills the picture from end to end, so each half of the picture shows a recognisable part of it, different from the other half. A calm, simple background in strong contrast with the subject, with only gentle texture. Strong shapes and clear, bold colours. No text, letters, numbers, logos, brand names, signature, watermark, border or frame.
suffix.postcard: A real travel photograph of a real place, as a good postcard shows it: natural, true colours, not oversaturated, no HDR glow, no painterly or illustrated look, no AI sheen. Clear air, sharp from front to back. One strong, recognisable feature of the place fills a large part of the picture with clear shapes and strong contrast, so one quarter of the picture holds a striking, easily recognised part of it; a calm sky. No people, no text, letters, numbers, signs, logos, watermark, border, frame or vignette.
suffix.candid: One clear subject, framed close and large: it fills most of the picture and reaches into every quarter of it, so any quarter of the picture shows a recognisable part of it. A calm, simple background in strong contrast with the subject, with only gentle texture. Strong shapes and clear, bold colours. The person is caught candidly in the middle of what they are doing, absorbed in it: in profile, from behind, from the side or looking down at the work, never looking at the viewer, never posing or smiling for the camera, the head not tilted. Ordinary, natural features and real skin texture, nothing glossy, airbrushed, plastic or doll-like; a natural, asymmetric pose. No text, letters, numbers, logos, brand names, signature, watermark, border or frame.
suffix.photo: Deep depth of field: everything sharp from foreground to background. Rich, fine detail and texture spread evenly over the whole frame, so any small square cut from it still shows recognisable detail; no large plain, empty or blurred areas, and only a modest amount of sky. Keep the main subjects away from the outer edges of the frame. A real professional photograph with true natural colours. No text, letters, writing, logos, watermark, border, frame or vignette.
suffix.painting: The painting fills the entire image edge to edge: no frame, no border, no visible canvas or paper edge, no signature, no text or writing. Rich detail spread evenly across the whole picture, so any small square cut from it still shows recognisable detail; no large plain or empty areas. Keep the main subjects away from the outer edges.
